title: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in OpenText…
description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in OpenText Directory Services (OTDS) versions 25.1 through 26.2 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts that could be executed in the context of a user's browser session.
